xBRIEFInfo.description: Route PR babysit/shepherd/watch on OpenClaw to Tier 1 Approach 1 background sessions_spawn review-monitor, not main-session gh poll + cron.

narratives.Description: Route PR babysit/shepherd/watch on OpenClaw to Tier 1 Approach 1 background sessions_spawn review-monitor, not main-session gh poll + cron. Live recurrence was APE on statusreport PR babysit freestyling poll and cron despite sessions_spawn availability.
narratives.Overview: Epic #2874 P0 symptom fix. Incident: APE statusreport babysit freestyled poll+cron despite sessions_spawn.
narratives.UserStory: As an OpenClaw agent babysitting a PR, I want review-cycle Approach 1 to use sessions_spawn, so that I do not freestyle main-session gh poll plus cron.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Edit content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md Review Monitoring Approach 1 to list OpenClaw sessions_spawn beside Cursor/Warp/grok-build. Step 2: Add #2261 supersession subsection for OpenClaw; document cron ≠ Approach 1. Step 3: Extend packages/core review-monitor register/verify to accept sessions_spawn primitive if those modules exist. Step 4: Prefer task pr:watch language. Step 5: CHANGELOG #2876. Verification: skill text grep + task check:merge. Touch concrete source files listed in plan.metadata.swarm.file_scope.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance criteria map to #2876; missing_traces_justification until implementation maps lines.

narrative.Acceptance: Given deft-directive-review-cycle Review Monitoring, when host is OpenClaw with sessions_spawn, then Approach 1 is the default path and #2261 babysit supersession text names OpenClaw.
Given review-monitor:register and verify:review-monitor, when primitive is sessions_spawn (or openclaw-sessions-spawn), then registration/verify succeed.
Given skill text, when read, then OpenClaw cron alone is not Approach 1 (scheduler fallback only if spawn unavailable).
